# Think Green Design | Build Landscape - Extended AI Reference

## Who This Is For
Homeowners in Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Phoenix, and nearby Arizona cities seeking premium landscape design-build services.

## What Makes Think Green Different
1. One team from design through construction
2. Focus on desert-climate durability and water efficiency
3. Consultation-first process for clear scope and communication
4. Family-owned studio with long-standing local experience

## Project Process
1. Free consultation at the property
2. Design concept and planning
3. Build scheduling and construction execution
4. Final walkthrough and warranty review
